InstallationLive dataFlow field

Tidal Memory

Oceanário de Lisboa · 12m LED wall · Permanent, 2025

A perpetual flow-field driven by the real tide height of the Tagus estuary outside. At slack water the currents calm; at spring tide they tear across the wall. The piece has run continuously since June 2025.

IdentityParametric

Helio Foundation

Generative brand system · 2024

One parametric mark, infinite legitimate variants. Each grant recipient is hashed into a unique, reproducible logo that still reads unmistakably as Helio.

PrintPlotter

Cell Census

AxiDraw pen-plotter edition of 200 · 2024

Each print maps one city's residential density into a Voronoi field, drawn in a single continuous ink stroke. Sold out in nine days.

WebGenerative drop

Soft Machines

On-chain generative series · 2023

A 512-piece browser-native series. The renderer is fewer than 9 KB and ships inside the token itself — no server, no IPFS image, just math.

EditorialTruchet

Truchet Hours

Cover system, MONO Quarterly · 2023

A magazine cover that re-tiles itself every issue from a Truchet grammar, so the masthead stays fixed while the field beneath it never repeats.

InstallationSound-reactive

Murmuration

Gulbenkian Garden · Projection mapping · 2022

A nightly projection across the garden's cedar grove. A boids flock responds to ambient sound, settling into stillness only when the garden falls quiet.

Data sculptureCNC

Phase Portrait

Aluminium relief, 2.4m · Private commission · 2022

A milled aluminium relief whose contours are the phase space of a chaotic pendulum — solid metal frozen mid-orbit.

IdentityPrint

Drift Atlas

Festival identity, Semibreve · 2021

A full festival identity grown from one Worley-noise atlas — posters, lanyards, and stage screens all sampled from the same generative map.

Quiet Engine

Dependency-free noise toolkit · Ongoing

The 4 KB noise-and-color library underneath most of our work — including the field you're looking at. Free, MIT-licensed, no build step.
